nodes.description: Public mapping holding token balances per address; mutated by transfer/transferFrom/batchSend/constructor
Public nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount; written by approve and decremented in transferFrom
Total token supply set in the constructor
Private owner address, assigned from msg.sender in the constructor
Set of privileged role addresses (dev, marketing, adviser, privateSale, publicSale, community, Binance, CoinmarketCap, Coingecko) used in require-based access control
Constant Uniswap router/pair address used in the SwapAndFarmingForGarDeners modifier
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _Convert, _value)
Public payable transferFrom guarded by the SwapAndFarmingForGarDeners modifier; performs unchecked balanceOf/allowance arithmetic and emits Transfer
Public payable approve that grants the same _value allowance to nine hardcoded role addresses from msg.sender
Public payable function with a multi-address require gate that performs a.delegatecall(b) to an arbitrary user-supplied address
Public payable batch transfer with privileged role require gate; computes total = _value * _Converts.length and mutates balances in an unchecked loop
Internal pure Uniswap-style CREATE2 pair address derivation used by the modifier
Payable constructor that initializes name/symbol/supply, sets owner and roles, and pre-approves the Uniswap router
Caller-controlled address used for balances, allowances, role comparisons and ownership assignment
Low-level delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address and calldata inside delegate()
Unchecked multiplication _value * _Converts.length that can overflow uint256
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total that can underflow
Recipient address parameter of transfer, forwarded to transferFrom
Amount parameter shared by transfer and transferFrom
Sender address parameter of transferFrom used as balanceOf/allowance key
Target address parameter of delegate, used as delegatecall destination
Bytes calldata parameter of delegate passed into delegatecall
Array of recipient addresses in batchSend and length multiplier for total
Per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend
Local variable holding _value * _Converts.length in batchSend

Nine role address parameters (dev, marketing, adviser, privateSale, publicSale, community, Binance, CoinmarketCap, Coingecko) of approve that all receive the same allowance

edges.reason: transfer forwards execution and value to transferFrom(msg.sender, _Convert, _value)
msg.sender is supplied as the _Load sender for the internal transferFrom call
_Convert recipient parameter flows into transferFrom and the balance credit
_value amount parameter flows into the balance/allowance arithmetic of transferFrom
_Load sender parameter indexes balanceOf and allowance in transferFrom
msg.sender is used as the spender key when decrementing allowance in transferFrom
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_Load] and balanceOf[_Convert] with unchecked -= and +=
transferFrom decrements allowance[_Load][msg.sender] without SafeMath
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][role] for each of the nine role addresses
The nine role address parameters become the spender keys written by approve
The i loop index controls iteration over _Converts in batchSend
Local total is compared against and subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender] in batchSend
_Converts.length is multiplied by _value to compute total in batchSend
_value is multiplied by the array length and credited to each recipient balance
Unchecked multiplication _value * _Converts.length inside batchSend can overflow uint256
Unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total inside batchSend can underflow the balance
batchSend directly writes balanceOf[msg.sender] and balanceOf[_Convert] without SafeMath
Parameter a is the arbitrary delegatecall target address in delegate()
Parameter b is the arbitrary calldata forwarded to delegatecall in delegate()
delegatecall executes arbitrary external code inside delegate(), enabling reentrant state manipulation of balanceOf/allowance
Arbitrary delegatecall code runs with this contract's storage, allowing reentrant writes to balanceOf
msg.sender is compared against owner and the privileged role list to gate delegate()
The privileged role list gates whether delegate() may execute the delegatecall
msg.sender is compared against owner and the privileged role list to gate batchSend()
The privileged role list gates whether batchSend() mints balances
The UNI constant participates in the SwapAndFarmingForGarDeners modifier gating transferFrom
pairFor derives the UNI pair address checked by the modifier guarding transferFrom
msg.sender becomes owner and receives the entire initial supply in the constructor
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender
The constructor sets balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply and pre-approves the Uniswap router
The constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply argument

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter of transfer is only meaningful as an argument to the transferFrom core function
Amount parameter used only to drive the balance/allowance arithmetic inside transferFrom
Sender parameter used only as the balanceOf/allowance key inside transferFrom
Target address parameter resolves directly into the delegatecall unsafe operation
Calldata parameter resolves directly into the delegatecall unsafe operation
Recipient array parameter is consumed by the batchSend loop and its length by the checked multiplication
Per-recipient amount parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication and balance credits in batchSend
Local total is the direct product of the unchecked multiplication inside batchSend
Loop index local used solely to iterate the batchSend recipient array
Role address parameters are used only as spender keys written by the approve core function
